editor.title: Constraints

errors.compileFailed: Failed to generate constraint from description.

editor.removeConfirm: The engine will stop blocking on this constraint. It cannot be restored from here.
editor.nlHint: AI turns your description into a rule and fills it in under Advanced. Review it, then press Add constraint to save.
editor.evaluateHint: Press Evaluate now to see this task's constraints and whether each one is satisfied.

replay.title: Replay
replay.description: Rebuilds this task's state from its event history and compares it with the stored state. Drift detected means the two disagree.

stateGraph.title: State graph
stateGraph.description: The states a task can pass through, with this task's current state highlighted. GitHub, Slack and Google light up when signals from them have reached this task.
